The exact-theorem, framework, consistency-null, and upper-limit sectors are correct at their labeled tiers after P1/P2 disclosure fixes: the DESI verdict survives the attacker's own corrected null (p~0.69), the ACT p=0.35 is honestly matched at tier, the curl no-go is strengthened rather than weakened by the stencil finding, the MES convention-dependence is disclosed in the manuscript's own load-bearing remark (verified at ch04:529), and the framework sector's self-retraction of its own sealed theorems is affirmative evidence of tier integrity. The failure mode is not fabrication — conservative branches exist in the cards, significances were withheld when the error model was untrusted, and the outer envelope was never breached — but hot-branch promotion plus one unmodeled catalog systematic gutted the headline layer, and the required fixes (retract C1, re-scope C2 to methodology, rebuild C3 at jackknife error, reword C10c, re-scope the ACT UL, relabel K6, propagate rev-r190) are major revisions that reduce the paper's claimed results rather than rescue them.
